description: Verjetnost pojavljanja plazov WMS services is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Metadata System Slovenia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserver.geo-zs.si. La carte indique les zones potentielles de glissement de terrain pour l'ensemble de la Slovénie dans six classes de probabilité d'occurrence de glissements de terrain; aucune probabilité, très faible probabilité, faible probabilité, probabilité moyenne, probabilité élevée, probabilité très élevée. La fiabilité des prévisions est d'environ 0,88. Coverage: SI. The portal shows the English title as "Landslide susceptibility map - WMS storitve" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inženirska geologija, geology, INSPIRE, matematični model, landslide, Slovenija. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2008-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-metadata-si.
